items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: His name is uh, he played with us too.

ctx.x: Cal Cahill? Cal, no it wouldn't be that. And there's another boy right down here who's a nice musician now. His name is uh, he played with us too. He's right there in the- What's that name again? Tontley Sallagier. Tontley Sallagier. Tontley Sallagier. What's that name again? Tontley Sallagier. Tony Sallagier. Sallagier. Sallagier. Sallagier. Sallagier. Yeah, he's living. He's still living? Yeah, he's right over there right now. He's working. Where in Seattle? No, he was a cornet player. A cornet player.
